subject.title: [Bug]: Skill Workshop agent-tool apply times out because approval wait exceeds tool watchdog

question: Should Skill Workshop lifecycle approvals be fixed by the broader non-wedging approval-flow PR, the narrow Codex timeout extension, or a split of those approaches?
rationale: Both open PRs can address the reported timeout, but they make different security and UX tradeoffs around approval wait budgets, proposal metadata, and timeout semantics.

options.title: Use the broader lifecycle fix
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 as canonical if maintainers want bounded approval waits, proposal metadata, and actionable pending-state timeout behavior in one security-reviewed change.

options.title: Use the narrow timeout mitigation
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91325 if maintainers want only Codex watchdog headroom and want popup detail or timeout semantics handled separately.

options.title: Split the overlap
options.body: Ask the PR authors to split or retarget the overlapping changes, then close the non-canonical PR once the chosen path is clear.

recommendation.title: Use the broader lifecycle fix
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 as canonical if maintainers want bounded approval waits, proposal metadata, and actionable pending-state timeout behavior in one security-reviewed change.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to this issue and authored the broader open closing PR that also covers related Skill Workshop approval reports.
